definitions.explanation: Having a great deal of something; wealthy or plentiful in resources.
Having depth, richness, or fullness in terms of experience, emotion, or expression.

notes:
USAGE: {豊|ゆた}か can describe material abundance (resources, nature) or abstract richness (experience, emotions, expressions).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊|ゆた}か (rich in nature)
・{豊|ゆた}かな⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (rich experience)
・⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊|ゆた}か (expressive, rich in facial expressions)
・{豊|ゆた}かな⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (prosperous life)
・⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊|ゆた}か (having a rich heart/spirit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ - to be rich in (verb)
・⟦{裕福|ゆうふく}→裕福：14041_yuufuku⟧ - wealthy, affluent (financial)
